dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Augereau
dialogues.text: I'm a member of the Gardes in charge of keeping Romaritime Harbor safe. Feel free to call for me if you encounter any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Augereau
dialogues.text: I've got a good pair of eyes and a quick pair of legs, so any suspect who wishes to escape outside our borders will have to pass me first.

dialogues.speaker: Augereau
dialogues.text: Haha, just kidding. I exaggerate, somewhat.

dialogues.speaker: Augereau
dialogues.text: People come and go all around this place, but most of the work is done by machines — everything's pretty well organized.
